description: Estimate the remaining balance, payments left and projected payoff date of a merchant cash advance from the advance amount, factor rate, amount already paid and the daily or weekly payment. Remaining balance = total payback - amount paid; daily payments skip weekends.

advance.description: Funded advance amount in USD, e.g. 50000.

amount_paid.description: Total already repaid in USD. Defaults to 0.

as_of_date.description: Date to project from (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC).

factor_rate.description: Factor rate, e.g. 1.35 (total payback = advance x factor rate). Between 1.0 and 2.0.

payment_amount.description: The daily or weekly payment amount in USD, e.g. 450.

name: estimate_mca_payoff
title: MCA payoff estimate
